净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Drawdown stress ratio (accumulated drawdown depth relative to volatility) adaptively dampened during high residual volatility periods to reduce noise and improve ranking stability. The primary mechanism from the drawdown stress parent is preserved; the gate from the volatility adaptive trend parent is added as a lightweight modifier.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

raw = cumulative_max_drawdown_sum_60d / 60d_vol; result = raw * (1 - 0.5 * I(style_gate_resvol_high > 0))

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
cummax累积最大值（截至当期的历史最高值）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 running_max：close.cummax()
  3. 计算 drawdown：(running_max - close) / running_max
  4. 计算 drawdown_sum：drawdown.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).sum()
  5. 计算 vol：returns.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).std(ddof=1)
  6. 计算 raw：drawdown_sum / vol
  7. 计算 high_resvol：style_gate_resvol_high > 0
  8. 计算 factor_values：np.where(high_resvol, raw * 0.5, raw)
  9. 计算 factor_values：pd.Series(factor_values, index=df_copy.index)
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_stress_ratio_gated(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] running_max = close.cummax() drawdown = (running_max - close) / running_max drawdown_sum = drawdown.rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum() returns = close.pct_change() vol = returns.rolling(60, min_periods=60).std(ddof=1) raw = drawdown_sum / vol.replace(0.0, np.nan) high_resvol = df_copy["str">'style_gate_resvol_high'] > 0 factor_values = np.where(high_resvol, raw * 0.5, raw) factor_values = pd.Series(factor_values, index=df_copy.index) factor_values.name = "factor_drawdown_stress_ratio_gated" "kw">class="kw">return factor_values
